[Momentum Indicators]

[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($460.21) — Based on Pivot S1($417.38) and 52-week low($149.22).
· Swing Resistance ($546.44) — Based on 52-week high($584.73) and Bollinger Upper Band($582.80).
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern — Absence of clear Higher Low or Lower High patterns, indicating a consolidation phase.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.33x) — Significantly lower volume compared to the 5-day average, reducing confidence in price movements.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Accumulation Phase) — Lack of directional conviction due to neutral RSI, bearish MACD convergence, trendless ADX, and subdued volume. Requires observation for indicator shifts before action.
